text:
incident-bot: Pager alert -> high 5xx rate observed from edge LB (us-east). Route: /v1/*. Notifying on-call @sana :rotating_light:

sana: ack, I'm oncall and joining. creating zoom now. sharing datadog link: https://dd.example.com/alerts/12345

mike: saw this too, spike started ~10:12 UTC, error rate ~8% across requests to /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings, but concentrated on us-east-gw-1

alex: in envoy logs I'm seeing upstream 502/503 and envoy retrying then hitting backend connection reset. sample from gw logs:
```
[2026-03-15T10:12:14Z] "POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1" 502 - upstream_reset
[2026-03-15T10:12:16Z] "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1" 504 - upstream_timeout
```

tiago: FYI I merged a routeset change in the canary earlier (routeset-v2). PR #412 changed rewrite rules and added a per-route retry policy. Could be overlapping route precedence.

joan: retries + bad route mapping = amplification. If a backend returns 502, retries will multiply load. recommend disabling retries at LB while we investigate.

sana: agreed. immediate mitigation: set per-route retries to 0 on the gateway to stop retry storms. Running command now.

infra-bot: running command:
```
kubectl -n gateway exec gateway-control-0 -- /bin/sh -c "curl -XPOST http://127.0.0.1:9001/config/routes/retries -d '{\"retries\":0}'"
```

infra-bot: response: 200 OK -> per-route retries set to 0 on gw nodes :white_check_mark:

mike: watching datadog: 5xx dropped from 8% -> 4% within 45s. good sign but still elevated on /v1/embeddings only.

alex: digging deeper — I see two matching route entries for /v1/embeddings. routeset-v1 routes to backend pool gen-core, routeset-v2 rewrote path to /v1/e and routes to gen-core-v2 which is not fully compatible (different expected payload). envoy chooses v2 for some requests -> backend returns 502.
tiago: that explains region-only behavior — canary was only on us-east nodes. I'll roll back the canary.

sana: agreed. Plan: 1) rollback routeset-v2 canary 2) leave retries disabled for 10 min to let traffic settle 3) temporarily raise circuit-breaker conn limits for gen-core to reduce 5xx from transient connection churn 4) run postmortem notes.

tiago: kicked rollback via gitops:
```
argocd app rollback gateway-routes 1 --server argocd.redwood.internal --auth-token $TOKEN
```

infra-bot: argocd response: rollback started, sync in progress.

joan: also applying a temporary CB tweak to gen-core backend pool:
```
bash -c "kubectl -n gateway patch cm envoy-cb --patch '{\"data\":{\"gen-core_max_conns\":\"200\"}}' && kubectl -n gateway rollout restart daemonset/gateway-proxy"
```

mike: metrics update: 5xx now 1.2% and trending down. Latency normalizing.

incident-bot: Update: rollback completed on canary nodes, config drift corrected. error rate returned to baseline (~0.2%) by 10:25 UTC.

sana: good recovery. I've started SLO impact calc — initial blast impacted ~0.4% of requests across US-EAST for ~12 minutes. tagging this Sev2. Opening incident ticket IR-2026-0315-01 and notifying support to surface to impacted customers.

alex: root cause summary (prelim): overlapping route precedence in routeset-v2 + incompatible backend mapping + enabled retries caused amplified 5xx during canary.

tiago: action items:
- revert routeset-v2 until compatibility testing is completed (done)
- add an automated canary check for route path rewrites vs backend contract
- make default gateway per-route retries = 0 unless explicitly needed
- add an alert for overlapping route matches on deploy

sana: assigning owners: tiago -> rollout guard & automated check, alex -> post-deploy contract test, joan -> default retry policy proposal, mike -> incident writeup and customer communication.

mike: contacting customer success with impact summary and mitigation steps now. drafting slack post for #customer-impact.

incident-bot: follow-up: please add timeline notes to IR-2026-0315-01 and attach relevant logs/commands. closing the on-call paging loop — if anything regresses, re-pager. :thumbsup:

sana: thanks team. I'll run a short blameless postmortem tomorrow. :coffee:
